message.reasoning_content: There's a git repo. Let me check git log for the original files to see if there's history revealing intended semantics for csvfix/impl.py. Let me look at git log for the workspace files.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)\" 2>/dev/null && pwd && git log --oneline -10 -- \"$(pwd)\" 2>&1 | head; echo \"===\"; git log --oneline -5 2>&1 | head"}
